name: 萆荔

identity.personality: Irreverent and impatient; raised brow and open challenging grin.

source.evidence: 其草有萆荔，狀如烏韭，而生於石上，亦緣木而生，食之已心痛。
facts: A plant called 萆荔 at 小華山.
Resembles 烏韭; grows on rock and also climbs trees.
The text attributes a heart-pain remedy; this is mythic literary content, not a modern medical claim.
originalDesignChoices: A 19-year-old female cliff-path scout, all face/hair/clothing/attitude.
Long green leaf ears, skin-to-green forearm transition, climbing stems and leafy fingers are original anthropomorphic translations.
Exact modern botanical identification and leaf shape remain unasserted.
